swarm.name: The Repeaters
swarm.blurb: A swarm of scavenged machines that copies signals and follows them as instructions.

crew.name: Wren
crew.blurb: Field medic. Keeps the crew running with thread and solder.

crew.name: Ox
crew.blurb: Shield bearer. Has walked out of worse.

crew.name: Kestrel
crew.blurb: Breaker. Finds the seam in anything and pulls.

creatures.name: Dynamo Mite
creatures.blurb: It feeds on turning shafts, then rushes the crew.

creatures.name: Pelton Skitter
creatures.blurb: Its bucket feet kick it forward in short bursts.

creatures.name: Capacitor Tick
creatures.blurb: It stores a charge before throwing itself at a target.

creatures.name: Phase Hound
creatures.blurb: Its sweeping run pressures a crowded crew.

creatures.name: Insulation Inspector
creatures.blurb: It wraps damaged swarm machines in protective layers.

creatures.name: Recloser Beetle
creatures.blurb: It reconnects damaged machines. Stop its repairs first.

creatures.name: Step-Up Stalker
creatures.blurb: Its crackling coils interrupt the crew before it strikes.

creatures.name: Wire Eel
creatures.blurb: It slides along cables and steals loose gold.

creatures.name: Rectifier Ray
creatures.blurb: Its concentrated discharge punches through shields.

creatures.name: Copper Vine
creatures.blurb: Its branches connect more swarm bodies to the circuit.

creatures.name: Gas Turbine Hunter
creatures.blurb: It stalls a target, then builds up a heavy rush.

creatures.name: Load Collector
creatures.blurb: It shields its generator and sweeps the crew while feeding the departing signal.

creatures.name: Fusekeeper
creatures.blurb: A small repair machine that protects the crew with replaceable links.

creatures.name: Dry-Cell Courier
creatures.blurb: Its independent battery helps Wren mend the crew away from the grid.

events.title: Lift power
events.text: The lift has two possible supplies. One is reliable. The other has salvageable parts.

options.label: Connect the old dynamo
options.result: The lift carries the crew past the worst of the damage.

options.label: Strip the replacement
options.result: The crew pockets the spare parts and climbs.

events.title: Out of step
events.text: The door motor needs its three contacts set in sequence. The copper contacts are valuable.

options.label: Set the contacts
options.result: The motor opens the door. Ox studies its bracing mechanism.

options.label: Take the contacts
options.result: The crew takes the copper and finds another way.

events.title: Water rights
events.text: A jet blocks the walkway and powers a refuge. Redirect it or cross through it.

options.label: Keep the water flowing
options.result: The spray knocks the crew about, but the refuge keeps its power.

options.label: Divert the jet
options.result: The crew pays for replacement supplies at the now-dark refuge.

events.title: False overload
events.text: The meter probes are on the wrong terminals. Correcting them takes time and spare wire.

options.label: Repair the leads
options.result: Wren learns to clear a bad signal from the circuit.

options.label: Sell the spare wire
options.result: The crew leaves the meter alone and keeps the proceeds.

events.title: Stored warmth
events.text: The shutters can warm a resting place or expose a cache outside.

options.label: Close the shutters
options.result: The crew rests in the retained warmth.

options.label: Open the shutters
options.result: Sunlight reveals a small cache of parts.

events.title: Mixed cells
events.text: A lamp needs a cell. The usable cells would also fetch a price.

options.label: Power the lamp
options.result: Its light lets Wren study a repair diagram.

options.label: Sell the cells
options.result: The lamp stays dark. The crew takes the payment.

story.intro: The swarm has taken the generators and left the lamps dark. Wren hears a pulse under the machinery. Ox calls it a distress signal. Kestrel follows the wires.

chapters.title: A useful current
chapters.text: The swarm takes power and carries it away. Wren keeps the crew moving with solder and thread. The pulse repeats whenever a machine starts.

chapters.title: The wrong load
chapters.text: Insulators protect swarm machinery while working tools are left exposed. Ox holds the line as Kestrel looks for a seam. The pulse now sounds like a request for more current.

chapters.title: A circuit with a destination
chapters.text: The captured machines feed one improvised grid. Wren hears the pulse leave along its output. The crew follows, assuming something farther away needs rescue.

story.bossIntro: The Load Collector joins a generator to every device it can reach. Its shielded coils keep the signal alive. Kestrel raises the crowbar. Ox gets in front.
story.outro: The grid falls quiet, but the pulse continues elsewhere. Wren copies its rhythm before the last meter stops. The crew follows it to a collection of electrical demonstrations.

creatures.name: Sewing Crawler
creatures.blurb: It stitches gear together, interrupting the crew.

creatures.name: Crystal Whisperer
creatures.blurb: It sends false calls through a mineral antenna.

creatures.name: Lamp Scavenger
creatures.blurb: It steals loose parts while its lamp flickers.

creatures.name: Circuit Swarm
creatures.blurb: Break it carelessly and its pieces form separate attackers.

creatures.name: Shadow Projector
creatures.blurb: Its moving shadows interrupt the crew.

creatures.name: Vacuum Pump
creatures.blurb: It winds up before dragging itself through the crew.

creatures.name: Glass Menagerie
creatures.blurb: Its bent tubes shield wounded neighbors.

creatures.name: Theremin Sentinel
creatures.blurb: Its rising tone calls more machines.

creatures.name: Timeline Centipede
creatures.blurb: Its linked artifacts separate into dangerous pieces.

creatures.name: Stage Rig
creatures.blurb: It shields damaged machines and sweeps the stage.

creatures.name: Discovery Mimic
creatures.blurb: Its spare connections repair damaged machines early.

creatures.name: Curiosity Engine
creatures.blurb: It guards its receiver while building more machines from the crew’s signals.

creatures.name: Crystal Receiver
creatures.blurb: A quiet receiver helps Wren find clear signals and repair the crew.

creatures.name: Show Guide
creatures.blurb: A mechanical guide shields the crew between electrical demonstrations.

events.title: Hold the light
events.text: The beam reveals a route, but the hot projector needs someone to hold it steady.

options.label: Hold the projector
options.result: The crew crosses; the holder leaves with a burn.

options.label: Take the mirror
options.result: The crew sells the mirror and finds a longer route.

events.title: Loose connections
events.text: The pieces can make a switch or be sold as a set.

options.label: Build a switch
options.result: The crew learns to interrupt a circuit.

options.label: Sell the kit
options.result: The intact pieces find a buyer.

events.title: Two voices
events.text: One position brings a survivor’s call into focus. Another reveals valuable swarm chatter.

options.label: Listen for the survivor
options.result: The survivor directs Wren to a supply of bandages.

options.label: Tune to the chatter
options.result: The chatter reveals a cache of spare parts.

events.title: Bag on a curtain
events.text: The bag will soon be out of reach. Cut it loose or climb for the pulley.

options.label: Cut it loose
options.result: The bag falls open and yields medical supplies.

options.label: Climb for the pulley
options.result: The pulley comes free and sells for a useful sum.

events.title: Glass pattern
events.text: Moving the tubes reveals a passage. Intact tubes are also valuable.

options.label: Rearrange the tubes
options.result: A hidden diagram teaches Ox a new way to cover an ally.

options.label: Sell the tubes intact
options.result: The crew carries the tubes away without breaking them.

events.title: One useful frame
events.text: A frame shows a hidden switch. Repairing the reel uses a valuable spare.

options.label: Repair the splice
options.result: The switch opens a cabinet containing a combat manual.

options.label: Sell the spare
options.result: The reel keeps looping. The spare finds a buyer.

story.intro: The pulse leads into a gallery of demonstrations. Ox expects a person in trouble. A crystal receiver answers in the same rhythm, then repeats his voice.

chapters.title: An audience of machines
chapters.text: The swarm has arranged machines as if a show is about to start. Kestrel finds cables leading toward a receiver. Wren listens for a human voice.

chapters.title: The signal answers
chapters.text: The receiver repeats Wren’s test signal before she finishes it. The call was made from borrowed sounds. It is not proof of a trapped person.

chapters.title: A question sent onward
chapters.text: The swarm is collecting responses, not calling for rescue. It has mistaken every answer for a request to keep demonstrating. Ox wants the noise stopped before it reaches the next site.

story.bossIntro: The Curiosity Engine has wired the gallery into its receiver. It makes new machines from each question and guards its own circuit. Wren cuts the test signal. The engine answers anyway.
story.outro: The engine breaks, and its last transmission contains a destination. The swarm is taking its collected answers to a larger archive. Kestrel calls that a poor place to leave an unanswered question.

creatures.name: Camera Scout
creatures.blurb: Its tiny lens spots the crew and disrupts their work.

creatures.name: Glider Hunter
creatures.blurb: It circles in warm air before diving.

creatures.name: Catalogue Crawler
creatures.blurb: It files loose valuables in its rolling drawers.

creatures.name: Archive Swarm
creatures.blurb: Its linked boxes bring more machines into the fight.

creatures.name: Conservation Shell
creatures.blurb: It seals wounded machines under protective plates.

creatures.name: Digital Loom
creatures.blurb: Its cable weave repairs damaged machines.

creatures.name: Penny Outrider
creatures.blurb: Its giant wheel builds momentum for a rush.

creatures.name: Future Prototype
creatures.blurb: It copies the crew’s moves a moment late.

creatures.name: Antenna Scavenger
creatures.blurb: Its static interrupts a target before a broad blast.

creatures.name: Object Collector
creatures.blurb: It protects itself and breaks through the crew’s shields.

creatures.name: Restoration Rig
creatures.blurb: It restores damaged swarm machines together.

creatures.name: Grand Demonstrator
creatures.blurb: It calls experimental machines and sweeps the crew away from its receiver.

creatures.name: Workshop Conservator
creatures.blurb: A careful workshop machine helps Wren repair the crew.

creatures.name: Future Host
creatures.blurb: It weighs possible routes and shields a wounded companion.

events.title: Quiet crossing
events.text: The reflector can mute the swarm signal or be sold for its metal.

options.label: Align the reflector
options.result: The quiet signal teaches the crew how to clear interference.

options.label: Sell the reflector
options.result: The crew takes the money and crosses under the noise.

events.title: Mixed collections
events.text: Sorting the boxes reveals a repair note. A brass trolley wheel is also valuable.

options.label: Sort the boxes
options.result: The note leads Wren to a stock of dressings.

options.label: Sell the wheel
options.result: The trolley lists to one side. The crew takes the proceeds.

events.title: Hot air
events.text: The updraft holds a glider aloft. Cooling the machine costs supplies; guiding it down risks a fall.

options.label: Cool the machine
options.result: The glider settles safely after the crew uses its coolant.

options.label: Guide the glider down
options.result: The glider lands, but its frame clips the crew.

events.title: Switch the rail
events.text: A loose rail can divert the engine. Its metal has value too.

options.label: Switch the rail
options.result: The crew saves the bicycle and studies its sturdy brake.

options.label: Sell the rail
options.result: The crew takes the rail away before the engine reaches it.

events.title: Reshelved
events.text: A repair manual is in the robot’s hands. Its brass clamps could pay for supplies.

options.label: Retrieve the manual
options.result: Wren learns an earlier repair technique.

options.label: Sell the clamps
options.result: The manual slips behind a shelf. The crew sells the brass.

events.title: One more test
events.text: A machine repeats the same experiment. A small adjustment may reveal a useful move; the copper switch is valuable.

options.label: Adjust the input
options.result: The crew observes a wide discharge and learns its pattern.

options.label: Sell the switch
options.result: The experiment stops. The switch sells well.

story.intro: The swarm reaches a museum of collections and experiments. It feeds its copied answers into an archive. Wren recognizes the same pulse, now coming from many machines at once.

chapters.title: Everything collected
chapters.text: The archive takes tools, records and working machines into the same circuit. Ox holds back a collector while Kestrel finds its joints. The swarm appears to want every answer it can get.

chapters.title: A flawed instruction
chapters.text: Wren compares the copied signals. Each started as a test, then was repeated as an instruction to continue. The swarm is trying to complete a demonstration that has no end.

chapters.title: A way to stop
chapters.text: The crew can give the archive a final answer by opening its main circuit. Kestrel finds the seam in its housing. Ox prepares to hold it open while Wren disconnects the receiver.

story.bossIntro: The Grand Demonstrator closes its armored housing around the receiver. It calls more machines and sweeps the floor to keep the circuit intact. The crew must reach the connection before the demonstration starts again.
story.outro: The receiver comes free. The repeated instruction stops, and the remaining machines fall silent. The swarm wanted to finish a demonstration; its borrowed answers kept telling it to continue. Wren packs the receiver. Ox carries it. Kestrel checks the seam once more.
